crossRefs.note: As they went out, behold, a mute man who was demon possessed was brought to him.
When the demon was cast out, the mute man spoke. The multitudes marveled, saying, “Nothing like this has ever been seen…
He was casting out a demon, and it was mute. When the demon had gone out, the mute man spoke; and the multitudes…

translations.web: They brought to him one who was deaf and had an impediment in his speech. They begged him to lay his hand on him.
translations.bsb: Some people brought to Him a man who was deaf and hardly able to speak, and they begged Jesus to place His hand on him.
translations.kjv: And they bring unto him one that was deaf, and had an impediment in his speech; and they beseech him to put his hand upon him.
translations.asv: And they bring unto him one that was deaf, and had an impediment in his speech; and they beseech him to lay his hand upon him.
